Can your AI coding agent actually *hear* what it builds? 🎧🤖

While modern autonomous agents can write code to generate digital media, they’ve always suffered from sensory blindness—they have zero feedback loops to evaluate the audio they produce. They write the sound generation script and just cross their fingers.

Meet Earshot: the tool that bridges the sensory gap for AI coding agents by providing CPU-only local audio processing, letting them listen to, critique, and programmatically synthesize sound effects for films and games. 🎬🎮

Here is how Earshot gives your agents ears:

🔍 Comprehensive Audio Analysis and Critique: Converts sound into readable semantic data, providing calibrated tags, descriptive matches, realness scores, second-by-second listening transcripts, and automated scorecards compared against professional references.

⚡ Programmatic Sound Synthesis and Forge: Enables AI agents to write code-based recipes using physical synthesis techniques and iteratively improve them using an automated critic that measures artifacts, tonal balance, and envelope shape.

📦 Built-in Sound Effect Bank: Ships with 201 programmatic sound effects and kits that can be rendered by ID with timed sync points for films without requiring external AI models or an internet connection.

🔌 Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server: Operates locally via a CLI, a Python API, and an MCP server designed to integrate seamlessly with AI agents like Claude Code.

Instead of treating audio output as a black box, your agent can now use Earshot to listen to its output, measure loudness and peak levels, check sync points against video cuts, and iteratively fix parameters entirely on local CPU resources. 

Check out the repo, drop a star, and give your coding agents the gift of hearing today:
https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot

Bridge the Model Context Protocol directly into Blender to orchestrate multi-agent 3D automation and visual scripting through local or cloud LLMs! 🧊🤖

Are you tired of AI models being completely isolated from heavy creative desktop applications? Writing manual boilerplate just to get an LLM to interact with Blender's complex bpy Python engine slows down every pipeline. 

LiCinCan/blender-ai-mcp-addon solves this by embedding a Model Context Protocol server and visual studio workspace directly into Blender. It lets LLMs inspect scenes, execute Python scripts, manipulate 3D assets, and coordinate multi-step workflows effortlessly.

Key Features Built for Tech & 3D Teams:
⚡ Built-in MCP Server: Supports authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP connections for external clients like OpenCode.
🛠️ 21+ Scene Tools: Comprehensive coverage for inspection, object creation, editing, viewport screenshots, dynamic bpy API lookup, and asset importation.
👥 Multi-Agent Team Chain: Architecture featuring managers, workers, and reviewers with structured task boards and automated error correction.
🌐 Universal Provider Flexibility: Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, local Ollama models, and custom API endpoints.

Use Cases:
• Automate repetitive 3D product-display scene generation and asset populating straight from text prompts.
• Build multi-agent quality assurance pipelines that programmatically inspect, render, and refine architectural or gaming assets.

Whether you are an AI software engineer, technical artist, or 3D tool developer, this repo provides the blueprint for exposing native desktop application state and tooling securely to external LLM agents.

👉 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/LiCinCan/blender-ai-mcp-addon

Stop wasting your API budget on bloated MCP tool servers for AI agent reverse engineering. 

Meet Leanrea: an ultra-lightweight, 8KB skill file that slashes token overhead by over 60% for AI agent reverse engineering tasks. 

If you are tired of routing commands through heavy Model Context Protocol wrappers and hundreds of unnecessary tool definitions, Leanrea is the fix. Instead of bloating your prompt context, it teaches AI coding assistants to execute standard shell-based recon commands directly.

Here is why your agent workflow needs it:
⚡ Zero Added Tool Definitions: Relies entirely on native agent Bash execution to slash token overhead and dramatically cut initialization costs.
🎯 Smart Command Router: Maps target types—like Electron app asar bundles, Mach-O binaries, Go binaries, and SQLite databases—to the absolute fastest raw command.
🛡️ Built-in Speed Patterns: Comprehensive trap lists extracted from heavy frameworks guide agents away from common analysis failures without manual intervention.
🔌 Seamless CLI Install: Installs instantly via the skills CLI and supports major AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.

Whether you are tracing proprietary features through compiled Electron bundles or auditing third-party binaries for security vulnerabilities, Leanrea cuts down latency, reduces turns, and saves serious API costs.

👉 Check out the repo and drop it into your workflow today:
https://github.com/aicodeking/leanrea

Colossus scale, native PC speed. 🏔️✨ Experience the Bluepoint remaster of Shadow of the Colossus natively on Windows PCs via an advanced game loader and Vulkan graphics translation layer.

For years, bringing console exclusives to desktop hardware meant running heavy, resource-intensive traditional emulators. ShadowOfTheColossus-PC solves this by acting as a native PC port loader for the PlayStation 4 version, executing the game's original x86-64 machine code directly on your host CPU while intercepting system calls and translating the proprietary graphics pipeline to modern Vulkan APIs.

Whether you are a systems engineer, graphics programmer, or reverse engineer, this codebase offers a masterclass in hardware abstraction and API translation. 

🔥 Key Technical Features:
• Direct x86-64 CPU execution coupled with a specialized shadPS4-derived Vulkan translation core.
• Custom launcher with automated asset validation, save migration, 4K resolution scaling, and ultra-wide 21:9/32:9 support.
• Configurable framerates (30/60/unlimited), experimental FSR 3 and DLSS-G frame generation, and texture streaming fixes.
• Modular system integration hooking directly into user-provided PS4 firmware components for authentic audio and behavior.

💡 Why Developers Need to Check This Out:
Study how to map proprietary console graphics APIs to cross-platform Vulkan SPIR-V, analyze binary loaders and system call interception methodologies, and review practical blueprints for thread handling and dynamic shader translation.

Explore the source code, inspect the memory management, and contribute today:
🔗 https://github.com/AjncSystem/ShadowOfTheColossus-PC

Tired of your smart TV serving up invasive telemetry, sponsored content rows, and manufacturer bloatware right on your home screen? 📺🔥

Meet CleanYourTV: the ultimate tool to reclaim your Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi without ever needing to root your device. 

The Problem:
Modern smart TVs are packed with preloaded junk, non-removable ad services, and constant tracking. CleanYourTV solves this by leveraging Wireless ADB to clean up your living room hardware, protect your privacy, and swap out the cluttered default interface for a sleek alternative.

Key Features:
⚡ Wireless ADB Debloating: Connect over Wi-Fi to backup device state and safely disable telemetry and ad packages using pm disable-user.
🛡️ Safe & Reversible: Nothing is permanently uninstalled, meaning a simple one-line restore script rolls back any change instantly.
🖤 Custom Minimalist Launcher: Installs a native, ultra-lightweight 280 KB launcher featuring a pitch-black home screen, customizable docks, ambient color glows, and a glass highlight grid.
🤖 AI-Driven Automation: Includes structured prompts for AI coding assistants like Claude Code to map packages and guide your debloating setup.

For Developers & Tinkerers:
Learn how to programmatically interact with ADB over Wi-Fi, script bulk package management for constrained embedded systems, build high-performance native UI overlays, and leverage AI for physical device automation.

Check out the repo and start customizing your setup today:
https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv
